title: Bear Den theme manifest (theme.json)
description: A theme is a folder <id>/ holding theme.json and its art. Built-in themes live in themes/ (compiled into the TV shell and the coordinator); owners add or override themes in $XDG_DATA_HOME/bear-den-tv/themes/<id>/. Every visual choice here picks from the engine's building blocks (docs/THEMES.md); any ornament name resolves to <name>.svg|png in the theme folder first, then to the built-in ornaments (apps/tv-shell/assets/ornaments/). Unknown keys are rejected so typos surface in `bear-den-tv themes validate`.

id.description: Must equal the folder name. Stored in layout.ui.background.

name.description: Shown in Settings → Theme and on phones.

aliases.description: Older layout.ui.background values that mean this theme (den-gradient → den).

accent.description: Default focus/accent colour; Settings applies it when the theme is chosen.

image.description: 16:9 picture, at least 1920×1080 (2560×1440 recommended) unless pixel is true. Optional: without it the gradient is the wallpaper.

pixel.description: The image is pixel art: drawn at a whole-number scale without smoothing (a 480×270 image draws 4× on a 1080p screen). The ≥1920×1080 advice does not apply.

top.description: Gradient behind (or instead of) the image, top.

bottom.description: Gradient bottom; also the lock screen and window colour.

palette.description: Colours of the decorations (stems/lines, two leaf tones, blossoms/cores, glows).

focus.description: Decoration grown around the focused card (top-right and bottom-left corners).

panel.description: Decoration hugging the featured panel's corners; defaults to focus.

scene.description: Corner scene on Home (the family at home).

bears.description: How visiting bears are dressed and what the cub chases.

carry.description: An ornament held in the paw, or "stick" for a toasting stick.

backdrop.description: Portrait picture for phones (~780×1260). Defaults to the wallpaper image.

veil.description: Colour of the dark veil over the backdrop.

classic.description: The theme's art for the Classic art style (layout.ui.art_style). Optional: without it Classic shows the main wallpaper and backdrop.

image.description: 16:9 smooth picture, at least 1920×1080 (2560×1440 recommended); an SVG scales to any screen. The main wallpaper's top and bottom colours still apply.

backdrop.description: Portrait picture for phones (~780×1260). Defaults to the classic wallpaper image.

sprites.description: Animated layers drawn over the wallpaper image at its scale (without smoothing when the image is pixel art).

sheet.description: Sprite sheet: the frames laid side by side, equal width, in one row.

x.description: Left of the sprite in the wallpaper image's own pixels.

y.description: Top of the sprite in the wallpaper image's own pixels.

tip_upright.description: Keep the tip upright on mirrored corners (flames, mushrooms).

extras.description: Ornaments that pop open along the path while focus stays (top corners).

extras_bottom.description: Same for bottom corners (mirrored vertically); defaults to extras.

extras_upright.description: Extras stand upright on the top edge (mushrooms).
